slides.title: 5 profile fixes that make seniors want to refer you
Show projects, not just marks
slides.body: A CGPA tells them you studied. A project tells them you can build. Add 2–3.

slides.title: Say what YOU built
slides.body: One line per project: your part, the tools, what changed because of it.

slides.title: Add the link
slides.body: GitHub, a demo, a case study. Seniors click before they put their name behind you.

slides.title: Skills you can defend
slides.body: Five skills you can talk about for 10 minutes beat twenty buzzwords.

slides.title: Say where you want to go
slides.body: Pick your target companies. Now alumni know exactly where to refer you.

slides.title: Not sure where you stand?
slides.caption: MyCampusForum's profile coach scores you 0–100 and shows your quickest next step.

slides.title: Save this before placement season
slides.body: Send it to the friend whose résumé still says 'MS Office'.
